critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1710 lines — still recommend router-splitting (auth/prefs, users, employees, departments, budget, reports, hypotheses, admin-guard middleware).

write_guard middleware silently swallows JWT decode errors (except Exception: pass); if a token is corrupt/expired, the request bypasses the guard and only fails downstream. Consider explicit 401 for malformed tokens.

write_guard grants 'editor' full write access without checking budget lock state — server relies on individual endpoints (e.g., create/update_employee) to enforce lock. This is fine today but is a scattered rule; a centralized 'is-locked' guard invoked from the middleware or a helper decorator would reduce risk.
budget-line PUT override endpoint shape not obviously listed (test skipped) — main agent may want to add integration test coverage once endpoint contract is documented.
